data.name: Mustakin
data.gender_notes: Mustakin is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘mustak’, meaning firm or steadfast. It signifies someone who is strong and determined, and who remains unwavering even in the face of adversity. The name Mustakin carries the meaning “Firm, Steady” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Mustakin usually hope their child will grow to embody firm, steady and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents a strong connection to the divine and a deep sense of inner strength.
data.etymology: Mustakin belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Firm, Steady.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mustakin total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
